annotations.title: US → Nigeria air shipment handoff to Doos Logistics (free)

description: Free. POST the shipment and both names. We run an OFAC name screen and refuse prohibited items and hazmat (400). Restricted items (liquid, perishable) need Doos's approval first: they get 200 with status ask_doos_first, a restricted notice, no price and no booking links. Otherwise we return the estimate, Doos's proof-of-purchase checklist, a summary to give Doos and Doos's booking links (status ready_for_doos). You book and pay Doos directly; we never book or take payment. Independent estimate from Ni Biashara LLC. Not affiliated with Doos Logistics. You book and pay Doos Logistics directly. Estimates from Doos's public rates retrieved 2026-10-19. No payment: this tool returns the handoff itself.
